title: Deterministic dimuon invariant-mass demo over a three-file subset

subset_strategy.description: Use filter-range 1-3 to constrain processing to a deterministic three-file subset.

steps: Lookup dataset metadata and confirm DOI/citation context.
Fetch XRootD file locations and keep a deterministic first three-file subset.
Apply validated JSON context (record 14220) to collision processing assumptions.
Run a dimuon selection and compute invariant mass histogram for the subset.
Report caveat that this subset is for deterministic demonstration, not full-precision measurement.
